The ethical approval for ex-vivo and in vivo animal procedures were approved by the Danish Animal Ethical committee. Primary mouse BMSCs (mBMSCs) were isolated from the bone marrow of wild-type 8-weeks-old C57BL/6J mice as described previously [17]. In brief, the femur and tibia were dissected from mice and bone marrow was flushed out with complete isolation media (CIM), which consists of RPMI-1640 (Roswell Park Memorial Institute), supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS; GIBCO), 100 U/mL penicillin (Gibco, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Darmstadt, Germany) and 100 μg/mL streptomycin (GIBCO). Cells were washed with PBS, filtered (through 70 μM nylon mesh filter) and cultured in 40 mL CIM in a 175-cm2 flask in 5% CO2 incubator at 37 °C. Non-adherent cells were removed after 24 h, passage 0 (p0) and sub-cultured in 10 ml of fresh CIM in 60-cm2 flask (p1). Cells were passaged every 1 week using 0.25% trypsin/1 mM EDTA.

Mouse stromal cell line ST2 was obtained from Leibniz Institute DSMZ-German Collection of Microorganisms and Cell Cultures (ACC 333, Braunschweig, Germany). Cells were cultured in DMEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 1% penicillin/streptomycin (P/S) (Gibco Invitrogen, USA).

Cells were induced to osteoblast differentiation for 12 days. Cells were fixed with 70% ice-cold ethanol for 1 h at − 20 °C, and stained with 40 mM Alizarin red S (AR-S; Sigma-Aldrich), pH 4.2 for 10 min at room temperature. Alizarin red stain was eluted using 10% (w/v) cetylpyridinium chloride solution (Sigma-Aldrich) with shaking for 20 min and the absorbance of the eluted dye was measured at 570 nm.

Cells were induced to adipocyte differentiation and then fixed in 4% paraformaldehyde for 10 min at room temperature. Cells were stained with Oil Red O (0.5 g in 60% isopropanol) (Sigma-Aldrich) for 1 h at room temperature to stain the fat droplets. Lipids were quantified by elution of Oil Red O in isopropanol for 10 min at room temperature. The absorbance of the extracted dye was detected at 490 nm. Oil Red O measurements were normalized to cell umber (measured by number of viable cells) and then represented as fold change over control non-induced cells.

Total RNA was extracted from cells using single-step method of TRIzol (Thermo Fisher Scientific) followed by phenol-chloroform extraction procedure. cDNA was synthesized from 1 μg of total RNA using revertAid H minus first strand cDNA synthesis kit (Fermentas). Quantitative real time PCR was performed with Applied Biosystems 7500 Real-Time system using Fast SYBR® Green Master Mix (Applied Biosystems, California, USA) with specific primers (Additional file 1: Table S1). The expression of each target gene was normalized to β-Actin and Hprt mRNA expression as reference genes, using a comparative CT method [(1/ (2delta-CT) formula, where delta-CT is the difference between CT-target and CT-reference] with Microsoft Excel 2007® as described [41].

Total RNA was extracted from mBMSCs and mBMSCs-FS that induced to osteoblast differentiation for 6 days. Osteogenic RT2 Profiler™ PCR array, containing 84 osteoblast-related genes (Qiagen Nordic, Denmark), was performed for each cDNA sample in triplicates using SYBR® Green quantitative PCR method on Applied Biosystems 7500 real-time PCR system. Data were analyzed after normalization to reference genes according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Isolate primary mouse bone marrow stromal cells
steps.instruction: Prepare complete isolation media (CIM) consisting of RPMI‑1640 supplemented with 10 % FBS, 100 U/mL penicillin and 100 µg/mL streptomycin. Dissect femur and tibia from 8‑week‑old C57BL/6J mice, flush marrow with CIM, wash cells with PBS and filter through a 70 µm nylon mesh. Seed cells in 40 mL CIM in a 175 cm² flask and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. After 24 h remove non‑adherent cells (passage 0) and transfer adherent cells to 10 mL fresh CIM in a 60 cm² flask (passage 1). Passage the cultures weekly using 0.25 % trypsin/1 mM EDTA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare CIM: RPMI‑1640 + 10 % FBS + 100 U/mL penicillin + 100 µg/mL streptomycin.
Dissect femur/tibia from 8‑week‑old C57BL/6J mice and flush marrow with CIM.
Wash cells with PBS and filter through 70 µm nylon mesh.
Seed 40 mL CIM in a 175 cm² flask; incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
After 24 h discard non‑adherent cells (p0).
Transfer adherent cells to 10 mL fresh CIM in a 60 cm² flask (p1).
Passage weekly with 0.25 % trypsin/1 mM EDTA.

steps.title: Subculture BMSCs at 1:2 split with bFGF
steps.instruction: Prepare complete culture medium (CCM): IMDM supplemented with 10 % FBS, 5 ng/mL basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF), 100 U/mL penicillin, 100 µg/mL streptomycin and 12 µM L‑glutamine. When BMSC cultures reach 90 % confluence, detach cells with trypsin/EDTA, split 1:2 into fresh CCM containing 5 ng/mL bFGF, and continue sub‑culturing at 90 % confluence using the same conditions for all subsequent passages.

substeps.instruction: Prepare CCM: IMDM + 10 % FBS + 5 ng/mL bFGF + 100 U/mL penicillin + 100 µg/mL streptomycin + 12 µM L‑glutamine.
When cultures reach 90 % confluence, detach cells with trypsin/EDTA.
Count cells and split 1:2 into fresh CCM with 5 ng/mL bFGF.
Repeat each time cells reach 90 % confluence.

steps.title: Isolate primary mouse neonatal osteoblasts
steps.instruction: Dissect calvariae from 3‑ to 4‑day‑old neonatal pups, perform sequential collagenase II digestions at 37 °C, collect the released cells (p0) and culture them in complete osteoprogenitor medium (COM): DMEM supplemented with 20 % FBS, 100 U/mL penicillin and 100 mg/mL streptomycin.

substeps.instruction: Dissect calvariae from 3‑ to 4‑day‑old pups.
Digest tissue sequentially with collagenase II at 37 °C.
Collect cell suspension (p0).
Culture cells in COM: DMEM + 20 % FBS + 100 U/mL penicillin + 100 mg/mL streptomycin.

steps.title: Subculture osteoblasts at 1:2 split with bFGF
steps.instruction: When osteoblast cultures reach 90 % confluence, detach cells and split 1:2 into fresh COM supplemented with 5 ng/mL bFGF. Continue sub‑culturing at 90 % confluence using the same medium for long‑term expansion.

substeps.instruction: When OB cultures reach 90 % confluence, detach cells.
Split 1:2 into fresh COM containing 5 ng/mL bFGF.
Repeat at each 90 % confluence passage.

steps.title: Culture ST2 mouse stromal cell line
steps.instruction: Obtain the ST2 cell line (DSMZ ACC 333) and maintain it in DMEM supplemented with 10 % FBS and 1 % penicillin/streptomycin.

steps.title: Alizarin Red staining of mineralized matrix
steps.instruction: After 12 days of osteogenic induction, fix cells with 70 % ice‑cold ethanol for 1 h at –20 °C, stain with 40 mM Alizarin Red S (pH 4.2) for 10 min at room temperature, elute the stain with 10 % (w/v) cetylpyridinium chloride while shaking for 20 min, and measure absorbance at 570 nm.

substeps.instruction: Induce osteogenic differentiation for 12 days.
Fix cells 1 h in 70 % ice‑cold ethanol at –20 °C.
Stain with 40 mM Alizarin Red S (pH 4.2) for 10 min at RT.
Elute stain with 10 % cetylpyridinium chloride, shake 20 min.
Read absorbance at 570 nm.

steps.title: Oil Red O staining of adipocytes
steps.instruction: Following adipogenic induction, fix cells in 4 % paraformaldehyde for 10 min at room temperature, stain with Oil Red O solution (0.5 g Oil Red O in 60 % isopropanol) for 1 h at room temperature, elute the dye with isopropanol for 10 min, measure absorbance at 490 nm and normalize to cell number.

substeps.instruction: Fix cells 10 min in 4 % paraformaldehyde at RT.
Stain with Oil Red O (0.5 g/60 % isopropanol) for 1 h at RT.
Elute dye with isopropanol for 10 min at RT.
Measure absorbance at 490 nm.
Normalize values to viable cell count.

steps.title: Extract RNA and perform quantitative RT‑PCR
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA using the single‑step TRIzol method followed by phenol‑chloroform extraction. Synthesize cDNA from 1 µg RNA with the revertAid H‑minus kit. Perform quantitative real‑time PCR on an Applied Biosystems 7500 system using Fast SYBR® Green Master Mix and gene‑specific primers. Normalize target gene expression to β‑Actin and Hprt and calculate relative expression with the comparative Ct method (1/(2^ΔCt)).

substeps.instruction: Extract RNA with TRIzol single‑step + phenol‑chloroform.
Synthesize cDNA from 1 µg RNA using revertAid H‑minus kit.
Run qPCR on Applied Biosystems 7500 with Fast SYBR® Green Master Mix and specific primers.
Normalize to β‑Actin and Hprt.
Calculate relative expression using 1/(2^ΔCt).

steps.title: Conduct osteogenic PCR array analysis
steps.instruction: Differentiate mBMSCs and mBMSCs‑FS for 6 days, extract total RNA, synthesize cDNA, and run the Osteogenic RT2 Profiler™ PCR array (84 genes) in triplicate on an Applied Biosystems 7500 system. Analyze the data according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

substeps.instruction: Induce osteogenic differentiation for 6 days.
Extract total RNA and synthesize cDNA.
Perform RT2 Profiler PCR array (84 genes) in triplicate on Applied Biosystems 7500.
Analyze results per manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Perform statistical analysis of experimental data
steps.instruction: Express all values as mean ± SD of at least three independent experiments. Compare two groups with Student’s t‑test (*P < 0.05, **P < 0.005). For multiple groups use one‑way ANOVA followed by Duncan’s multiple range test (P ≤ 0.05) using SPSS version 16.1.
